item.title: Railway ticket cancellation new rules; check before cancelling ticket
item.description: Indian Railways has introduced updated guidelines regarding the refund process for confirmed train ticket cancellations. As per the revised rules, passengers who cancel their confirmed tickets between 24 and 72 hours before the scheduled departure will receive a refund after a deduction of 25% of the ticket fare.
